test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: Some sisters are brothers.

Very few balloons are sisters.

Conclusions: I. Some brothers are balloons.

II. Some brothers are not balloons.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.
Both the conclusions I and II follows.

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/910caa4a0607b4f6fc1d35c6e496709541cd0ebe29a54a26bcab53a85aa7dc21.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some brothers are balloons → False (Some sisters are brothers and very few balloons are sisters implies that it is possible but not definite).

II. Some brothers are not balloons → False (Some sisters are brothers and very few balloons are sisters implies that it is possible but not definite).

Here, we can see that both statements are complimentary to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
